hook: A legal war between music giants has dragged on for 8 years.

sections.voiceover: A legal war between music giants has dragged on for 8 years.
Why did AEG Presents file a 25-count lawsuit against Danny Wimmer Presents in November 2018?
Tensions peaked when Danny Wimmer Presents rejected an 18.9 million dollar buyout offer from AEG.
Los Angeles Superior Court judges scheduled a February 2027 jury trial to settle this dispute. AEG filed the 25-count lawsuit to resolve ownership stakes in Rock on the Range festivals.
The 8 year legal battle heads to a final jury trial.
